standardize HI and round data to 2 decimal points

info.short_description: Number of students enrolled at the reporting level.
info.long_description: Enrollment count reported by the source. Used as the denominator for the coverage and exemption percentages in the same record.

info.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination in the state's annual school immunization survey. The antigen-specific series definition, the grade(s) assessed, and whether the figure reflects all enrolled students or only those surveyed vary by state; see the source description.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for DTaP/Tdap vaccination.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with any vaccination exemption
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with any exemption (medical or non-medical) from vaccination requirements.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students with at least one vaccination exemption of any type, combining medical and non-medical exemptions. Where a state reports the categories separately this is their sum; overlap handling depends on what the source publishes.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a vaccination exemption of any kind.
